steps.text: Open the Symbols menu in the bottom panel and switch to Netlist.
Open Netlist Types to define a reusable wire style.
Click Add and name the new type control.
Set Wire Thickness to 4. The normal thickness is 1.
Click the Wire Colour cell on the control row to open the colour picker.
Enable Override colour, then enter 007F5F in the Hex field for green.
Click OK in the colour picker, then OK again in Netlist Types.
Click the OUT wire above R2. TinyCAD highlights its row in the Netlist view.
On the highlighted OUT row, open the Type list and choose control.
Click a blank spot on the schematic to see the green, thicker OUT wire.
